scripts.deploy:build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:prisma && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.predeploy:build: node scripts/verify-railway.cjs || echo 'Verification completed with warnings'
scripts.ensure:prisma: pnpm run prisma:generate || pnpm --filter @tempwallet/prisma exec prisma generate --schema=packages/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build:prisma: pnpm --filter @tempwallet/prisma run build || (echo 'Prisma build failed, trying alternative...' && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/prisma exec pnpm prisma generate && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/prisma exec tsc)
scripts.deploy:start: pnpm --filter @tempwallet/prisma exec pnpm prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/backend start:prod
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/frontend run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/frontend run build
scripts.verify:deps: pnpm --filter @tempwallet/shared run build && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/prisma run build && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/backend run build
scripts.build:frontend:deploy: pnpm --filter @tempwallet/shared run build && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/frontend run build
scripts.build:backend:deploy: pnpm --filter @tempwallet/shared run build && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/prisma run build && pnpm --filter @tempwallet/backend run build
